text:
maria: Quick async check — KV prefetch + continuous-batching sprint status. TL;DR: kernel prefetch PR merged to staging, canary shows ~8% p95 latency regressions on some workloads. Need eng-infra to cut a canary kernel-lib, eng-sre to prep rollback runbook. Who's owning post-merge validation?

kevin: I'll own post-merge validation. Running the full perf suite now. I suspect regressions correlate with the recent eviction scheduling change. Will post traces in ~30m. @jess please hold off on merging the batching optimizer until we confirm.

jess: saw the canary traces briefly. Two patterns: (1) eviction frequency spikes when seq_len > 1024, (2) KV warmup incomplete for reused sessions causing cold misses. Quick reproduce snippet below: 

```
# quick reproduce
ABORT_ON_FAIL=1 pytest tests/kernel/test_kv_warmup.py::test_reuse_sessions -q
```

I'll open a PR to add a guard in the optimizer for seq_len handling.

ops-bot: ci/status: staging-build-3777 — 1 failing test (tests/kernel/test_kv_warmup.py::test_reuse_sessions). Link: https://ci.company/3777

maria: OK thanks. Dependencies / owners needed: eng-infra (@nate) needs to release kernel-lib 2.4.1-canary with eviction fix, eng-sre (@sam) to prepare a short rollback/runbook and watch the canary. Can we hit these by EOD?

kevin: ETA for perf traces: ~27m. If we need an infra release, @nate can we get a canary build today? Marking PR #4521 blocking for now.

nate: I can cut the canary build but need the kernel-lib PR merged. @kevin can you file the minimal patch for the eviction threshold? I can backport it into a canary.

kevin: Filed PR #4523 with the minimal threshold tweak and rationale. Requesting review from @jess and @tim. cc: @maria.

jess: reviewing now. small docs nit, but code looks good. once merged I'll re-run batching optimizer tests.

tim: quick infra note — if we change eviction threshold we should update the autoscaler policy to avoid unintended scale churn. Small config change suggestion: 

```
# infra autoscaler config
eviction_threshold: 0.75  # was 0.65
```
I'll open PR to adjust autoscaler after kernel-lib canary is cut.

maria: Owners & actions (please ack):
- kevin: post-merge perf traces + follow regressions (owner)
- jess: review & adjust optimizer + run tests (owner)
- nate: prepare canary kernel-lib build (blocking)
- sam: create rollback/runbook and watch canary (blocking)
- tim: autoscaler config PR (follow-up)

Please update status here when done. If any blocker pops up, call for a quick standup.

kevin: Perf traces uploaded: https://perf.company/trace/877 — shows frequent evictions clustered at batch boundaries when seq_len spikes. If infra build is delayed I'll revert the scheduling change as fallback.

jess: merged optimizer guard branch to staging, running tests now. will ping when green.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy/staging/3777 started by @nate

tim: filed autoscaler PR #777, tagged @eng-infra for review.

jess: tests are green. batching optimizer merge queued.

maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups: kevin to run end-to-end canary once nate's build is ready; sam to publish the runbook. :thumbsup:

kevin: will run the canary after the build and ping in ~45m.

maria: ack. Closing async check-in for now — update this thread when done or if anything blocks. :sparkles:
